title: Trace a requirement to current evidence and back
statement: As a reviewer, I can traverse from a human requirement to current design, test, and code evidence and back, so that I can judge support and understand change impact.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each story shows the people it serves.
Each criterion shows its current design path.
Each criterion shows its current test path.
Each criterion shows its current code path.
A source location shows the requirements connected to it.
A source location shows the explanations connected to it.
Each evidence path is labeled current, missing, or stale.
Changed code lists the requirements it may affect.
Changed code lists the people it may affect.
An active persona with no accepted story appears as a visible gap.
